answer: Neighbor-quorum bond: a new identity enters one inlet with one key-signed signal from four established neighbors, each locking 30 credits after one check. Its 70-credit bond is a branch on the juniper registry, where star clusters show. One fake costs 70 plus 4x30, or 190; 1,000 fakes cost 190,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented neighbors fail: a key signing twice burns 30 credits and loses status. An honest agent pays 70 once and keeps its share.
